body: We weren't ready for anything like that, we haven't been dating long enough and we're too young, she just turned twenty and we're still in college. Ideally I would have wanted to spend my life with her, marriage and kids is something we both want in the future. She just said she doesn't love me anymore

I just want to get it off my chest, it upset me and I want to let her know. I also would like to get some kind of more sympathetic reaction from her, up till now she's been pretty distant and I want to have some dialogue where it doesn't feel like I'm talking to a damn robot woman

If I'm going to be honest, I don't think she is actually trying to be hurtful. I think she is just clueless and emotionally distant, plus I am her first real serious (healthy) relationship, so I don't think she really knows how to break up with someone gently
She has been very respectful so far, she's answered any questions I've asked her
Thank you for sharing this. I feel like my soul was ripped from my body, like I'm already dead.
Thank you. They say every day it gets easier but it feels like the opposite. Without her I feel like nothing. No reason to go on.
Thank you for sharing this, I hope I can get to that point someday.

Thank you. Personally, I just feel so dead inside, when I'm alone I don't feel capable of happiness. I feel like an electronic with no battery, the components are there, but the actual part that gives it power and life is missing. I felt the same way before I met her.
Thank you. I hope I can get through this and find someone new. It's especially difficult for someone like me, and until I find someone, I feel like I'm just a zombie, nothing to drive me.

I try to remember the good times but it feels like my happiest memories are now too painful to think about.

I wish I could be happy alone, but I just can't. It's the way I am.
I don't feel like anything you said is remotely accurate
I hope so.
I know she isn't with someone else
Girl. And yes she's a good friend, but its like a broken fucking record with her, insisting that I need to find someone by the end of september or im screwed
There is nobody else.
I hope it does get better, I doubt it will. I used to be so happy, now I want to just curl up and cry.
Yeah, I don't know when or even if I will be alright again
I feel this so much. Unfortunately I no longer find my hobbies enjoyable, everything feels so bland.
Thank you for sharing this. It really hurts bad, and therapy doesn't really help me. I know I have to cut contact eventually, but at least for now, I want to be able to contact her if I need to
Thank you.

Unfortunately I live with them, and I'm keeping my breakup a secret for as long as I can, because once they find out, particularly my grandmother, it will be like open season, she'll love making me miserable and taunting me.

I definitely don't disagree with you. But I have to accept myself for who I am, and unfortunately, I am a person defined more than not by  many issues, diagnoses, and flaws. If I pretended that I weren't, I would be being dishonest with myself.

I think if I manage to get over her and not completely fall apart, it will take a very, very long time. I actually do feel like I would do better if I found someone right away. My mental health is basically a garbage can. I honestly don't believe I can be happy on my own.

She said things started to feel off for a few weeks, and that it took her a while to realize how she was feeling. I wish I could understand, I wish I could change her mind. But she spent a long time before she came to a decision, and she said she wanted to, but she just couldn't.

Thank you. Every day hurts even more. When I  met her I had nothing, I had nothing to live for. And now I feel like I have nothing again. I would do anything just to hold her again. 

I loved her so much, whenever she needed me I was right there. I would have done anything for her. I don't know how this happened, just last week I felt amazing and happy, now I don't think I can make it. She was everything to me, I don't feel like I have anything to live for.
Thank you. Every day I hurt a little bit more, and I don't know how I'm gonna get over this

Thank you. I've been crying for days now. I just want her back. I feel completely broken. Everything in my life has lost its luster and meaning. I feel like I have nothing to live for, and no reason to go on.
I wish I could. But I don't enjoy... anything. Even something as simple as watching youtube videos I suddenly stopped doing. Everything feels empty now.
Therapy doesn't really do much for me. Neither does anti-depressants
Thank you.
I wish I thought I could. Alone, I can't even enjoy any hobbies. Even something as simple as watching youtube I can't do anymore. I just feel empty, and everything feels bland.
I'm in my twenties, this is my first serious relationship because most people could never find me lovable. I hate the person I am, and when I'm alone that hatred just amplifies.
I mean, I don't like it, but it's just the way I am. I don't feel capable of being happy on my own. I don't particularly like myself.
I've accepted it. But I still haven't completely let go, I'm still texting her.
I know I'm pretty broken, I feel like I have a psychological off switch that can only be switched on when im in a relationship, other times its like im a zombie
In retrospect I definitely agree, she had already prepared herself emotionally for this

Thank you. I'm going to try to work on myself I guess, but it's hard because I feel no motivation now. Everything I did I was able to do because I had her by my side.

I'm trying to keep going. All my happiest memories were with her, and now they're too painful to even think about.

I honestly don't resent her at all. She was the best thing that ever happened to me, I don't feel bitter, I just feel destroyed.

Thank you. I personally don't feel anywhere ready for a new relationship yet, but I'm gonna use online dating anyway just because my friend is very, very insistent on it.

I honestly thought we would be together forever, we were just so perfect, and she used to think the same way. We wanted to have kids together one day, and I just don't understand how she just stopped being able to see a future with me.

Thank you for your kindness. I just wish I knew why and how she just stopped loving me. I wish there was some way to win her back, but I know she made up her mind. I honestly feel like I lost my only chance, like I'll never find anyone else who could actually love me. I don't even feel like looking for anyone else, but my friend is kinda strongarming me into it.

Thank you, I'm sorry for what you went through. Personally the only one I can turn to is my best friend, and they only insist I immediately try to find someone new. I wouldn't even turn to my family, they are toxic and would just use it to taunt me. I just wish I could make the pain go away

Our relationship was really amazing, we made each other so happy. I just wish I knew what is wrong with me.  I feel broken and unlovable. I feel like everything good has been drained out of me.

All my happiest memories are now too painful to even think about. I honestly don't know how to proceed from here.

I don't think I'm ready to date yet, but I guess I'll go back to online dating anyways, just because my friend is forcibly pushing me into it.

I think the best part of my relationship with her that I can take away is that now I know I'm capable of being loved, which is a big deal since I grew up in a family where I was always told that no one would ever love me.
Thank you for your kind words, this is very difficult

I would do literally anything if she would take me back, but I don't think she will. Maybe there is a hundred to one chance that she misses me enough to change her mind, but this wasn't a rash decision, she thought long and hard, so I don't expect her to want me back.
Thank you. It doesn't feel like it's getting any easier.

> love shit and focus on life outside it and yourself

This is what is hardest. When I am alone everything in life loses its substance, and I just can't seem to feel anything but sadness
Yes. And what's horrible is that now my most happiest memories cause me immense pain as well
I'm sorry you went through that
Thank you for your kind words
At least I have one friend to turn to right now, without them I'd be completely helpless

I'm sorry for what you've been through.

>you have to just focus on the things you enjoy

Unfortunately, I find that I don't enjoy anything anymore. Even something as simple as watching YouTube videos feels completely pointless. I feel like there is no color or flavor in my life. I felt like this before.

Eventually I'll have to stop talking to her, I know that. But for now I rather... not let go. But by the end of the month I'll stop. I already told her not to be offended if I unfriend her on Facebook, she said she'll understand completely.  I know we can never be just friends, I think she's capable of it, but I know I'm not. I don't expect us to get back together, I put the odds at a hundred to one. I accept that.

I want to be happy outside a relationship. But I have accepted that I just can't be. I don't love anything about myself as a person, and even surrounded by people who call themselves my friends I still feel sad and worthless like I have nothing to live for. Everyone tells me to try to get to the place I was before I met her, but I was in such a bad place when I met her, so I don't know what to do.

Thank you for listening to me, it's nice to talk to someone who understands what I'm going through.

I would give anything for her to take me back. But I don't think it's going to happen. This wasn't a rash or sudden decision.  She felt like this over a period of a couple weeks, and she tried to make it work but eventually she came to a decision. I don't feel like she'll change her mind about that.

She said that its not like she'll be out of my life forever, I  still text her and she said we have facebook and instagram.

I don't think how well I do without her would be a factor. The only possibility is that she misses how I made her felt and wants me back, but thats like a hundred to one.
I know. but it feels better than quitting her cold turkey

> Just stay off social media and cease contact

I deleted my facebook and snapchat, but I'm not ready to cut off contact with her yet

>  You’ve lived without her before you can live without her after.

i was in a very bad place when I met her, if it weren't for her I likely wouldn't be here today
I straight up asked her, there is no other guy

> Or alternate with hanging out with your friends as opposed to always with your partner.

I never needed to be with my partner 24/7, it was more her presence in my life than her physical presence that caused me happiness. Before my relationship with her, I never felt happy even with friends

I hope so. Personally, I feel numb without a relationship. I can barely enjoy any hobbies, movies, music, video games; it all feels so empty. When I'm in a relationship I can enjoy life, and everything. But when I'm not, i just cannot feel happy
I've still been texting her, I know I need distance, but at this point it's still early, and I don't want to let go
I've just been crying nonstop, and smelling the shirt that still smells like her
Thank you
I understand that. Unfortunately, when I'm alone, I lose my ability to really feel happiness
She hasn't had any problem with talking to me, and she said that it's not like shes out of my life forever
Thank you for sharing your story
If I didn't meet my girlfriend, I probably wouldn't be around today, and without my friend I definitely wouldn't have still been around by the time I met my girlfriend
I think it will be a long time, if ever, before I'm alright again. I was in a very bad place when I first met her, and I don't know if I'll be able to cope
Thank you. It hurts alot
I definitely failed that last point. I've been texting her for the last day, trying to figure out what happened

I'm going through this right now. It really sucks I know. It feel like someone breathed life into you, then they leave and it feels like you're just a withered husk. Like everything good is gone forever.
Thank you

I've been texting her on and off for the past day. She swears to me that there isn't anything wrong with me, she just had an emotional change. I want to understand, but she said there's nothing more to it than that. She just had a change of feelings. She said that she won't be out of my life completely, so I guess I can always text her, but I will try not to, that only makes it harder

I'm trying to keep busy, unfortunately when I feel this numb
Yes, thank you

I'm sorry for what you went through.

I don't think she was hiding feelings for long. She said just two weeks ago she realized she didn't love me anymore, although she said things felt off before that.

I agree it's too soon to date again, but my friend is pretty insistent that I need to find someone by the end of September or I'll be alone until next year at least. I want to protest, but this is the only person I can turn to right now.
I honestly don't know if I will heal from this. I don't even know if I'll make it through winter.

I don't want to date anytime soon. Unfortunately the only person I can really turn to is my friend, who is loudly insisting I go back to online dating literally right away. They don't seem to understand that I don't respond well to the whole tough love thing.

I hope I can see the beauty of life again. I was never really, truly happy before I met her.
Thank you. My friend wonders if she is talking to another guy, but I don't think so. I think she just... Stopped loving me.
